fallback.assessmentTailExplore: You have not yet locked in a clear target; your skill mix and interests point to several promising tracks, but a direct transition would be difficult, so an internship or project-based bridge is needed.
fallback.assessmentTailTarget: Your target direction is {target}. Your background is somewhat transferable to it, but the hard-skill gaps are clear; starting in an assistant or operations role is recommended.
fallback.choiceAnalysis: Based on your choices, you tend to take a {team} style within a team, and under pressure {pressure}. Combined with your personality profile {archetype} and your resume experience, these traits offer some reference value for the recommended directions, but they are not enough on their own to support a transition.
fallback.resumeSummary: Your resume shows that your {role} background brings transferable capabilities such as communication, coordination, and understanding requirements, but you lack the core hard skills required for your target direction. We recommend spending 3–6 months on internships or projects to build your portfolio before applying for full-time roles.
fallback.aiAnalysis: In the AI era, some repetitive work in {role} roles is being replaced by automation tools. Be objective: among your core capabilities, communication, coordination, and complex judgment are hard for AI to replace, but repetitive execution work is being compressed quickly. Embrace AI tools to improve efficiency while moving toward work that requires a human touch and complex judgment.
fallback.riskDirectSwitch: Switching directly from {role} to {target} has a low success rate; entering through an assistant or operations role is usually necessary.
fallback.riskSalary: Salaries may drop 30–50% early in the transition, so plan for a 6–12 month income bridge.
fallback.riskNetwork: Industry connections must be built from scratch; internships or community events can help you establish them quickly.
fallback.feasibilityHigh: Your current capabilities align reasonably well with the target role, but you still need 3–6 months of project experience before applying formally. Validate the direction through an internship or side project first.
fallback.feasibilityMedium: Your soft skills partially match the target direction, but the hard-skill gaps are clear. A direct transition will be difficult; start in an assistant or operations role and seek an internal transfer after 6–12 months.
fallback.feasibilityLow: The gap between your current capabilities and the target role is large, so a direct transition is unrealistic. Choose a transitional direction closer to your current abilities (such as operations or assistant work), or build six or more months of internship and project experience before trying again.
